westermann-praise: Claus Westermann, Praise and Lament in the Psalms, trans. Keith R. Crim and Richard N. Soulen (1981)
bavli-moed-katan: Babylonian Talmud (completed about AD 500–600), tractate Moed Katan
bavli-avodah-zarah: Babylonian Talmud (completed about AD 500–600), tractate Avodah Zarah
fox-proverbs: Michael V. Fox, Proverbs 1–9 and Proverbs 10–31, Anchor Yale Bible 18A–18B (2000, 2009)
fox-proverbs-hbce: Michael V. Fox, Proverbs: An Eclectic Edition with Introduction and Textual Commentary, The Hebrew Bible: A Critical Edition (2015)
waltke-proverbs: Bruce K. Waltke, The Book of Proverbs, 2 vols., New International Commentary on the Old Testament (2004–2005)
murphy-proverbs: Roland E. Murphy, Proverbs, Word Biblical Commentary 22 (1998)
clifford-proverbs: Richard J. Clifford, Proverbs: A Commentary, Old Testament Library (1999)
toy-proverbs: Crawford H. Toy, A Critical and Exegetical Commentary on the Book of Proverbs, International Critical Commentary (1899)
mckane-proverbs: William McKane, Proverbs: A New Approach, Old Testament Library (1970)
longman-proverbs: Tremper Longman III, Proverbs, Baker Commentary on the Old Testament Wisdom and Psalms (2006)
bhq-proverbs: Jan de Waard, ed., Proverbs, Biblia Hebraica Quinta 17 (2008)
cook-lxx-proverbs: Johann Cook, The Septuagint of Proverbs: Jewish and/or Hellenistic Proverbs?, Supplements to Vetus Testamentum 69 (1997)
tov-recensional-proverbs: Emanuel Tov, "Recensional Differences between the Masoretic Text and the Septuagint of Proverbs," in Harold W. Attridge et al., eds., Of Scribes and Scrolls (1990), 43–56
swete-lxx: Henry Barclay Swete, ed., The Old Testament in Greek according to the Septuagint, 3 vols. (Cambridge; first edition 1887–1894; the text used on this site is from the later editions of 1907–1912, in the 1930 digital text): the text of Codex Vaticanus with the readings of Sinaiticus, Alexandrinus and others
djd16: Eugene Ulrich et al., Qumran Cave 4.XI: Psalms to Chronicles, Discoveries in the Judaean Desert 16 (2000), including 4QProv-a (4Q102), 4QProv-b (4Q103), 4QCant-a, 4QCant-b and 4QCant-c (4Q106, 4Q107, 4Q108, edited by Emanuel Tov), 4QQoh-a (4Q109) and 4QQoh-b (4Q110)
healey-targum-proverbs: John F. Healey, The Targum of Proverbs, The Aramaic Bible 15 (1991)
rashi-proverbs: Rashi (Rabbi Shlomo Yitzhaki, died 1105), commentary on Proverbs
midrash-mishlei: Midrash Mishlei (Midrash on Proverbs), probably compiled AD 800s–900s; trans. Burton L. Visotzky, The Midrash on Proverbs (1992)
